name: Mechanical recycling of plastics
principle: Plastic waste is sorted (NIR, laser, X-ray), milled, washed, floated, dried and remelted. Heat and shear shorten polymer chains, so quality often limits recyclate to lower-value uses; only PET is approved for food-contact mechanically recycled post-consumer waste in the EU (Regulation 282/2008). In 2018, 32.5% of European post-consumer plastic waste was collected for recycling.

performance.metric: European post-consumer plastic waste collected for recycling, 2018

source.note: European Bioplastics, mechanical recycling best practice (2018 data)

limitations: Downcycling and contamination; EU targets 50% of plastic packaging recycled by 2025 and 55% by 2030
